articles.title: Signs of life?: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: Several sources told CoinDesk that a new draft of the Clarity Act may drop this week, but challenges remain.

articles.title: Stablecoin market cap has shrunk by $10 billion since May, but analyst sees no reason to panic
articles.snippet: The market shrank by $7.7 billion in June alone, the largest dollar amount since May 2022's Terra-Luna crash, but stablecoins will likely resume their long-term growth, one analyst said.

articles.title: Bitcoin is nearing a power law support line Fidelity has tracked since 2015
articles.snippet: The group's Dir. of Global Macro Jurien Timmer calls it an accumulation zone but notes the lack of a catalyst to bounce yet.

articles.title: Bitcoin, ether little changed as U.S. launches fresh Iran strikes
articles.snippet: The U.S. hit Iran for the third time this week and Tehran has reportedly closed the Strait of Hormuz again.

articles.title: Ripple once weighed shutting down and handing XRP to shareholders, CEO says
articles.snippet: Ripple's Brad Garlinghouse says he and co-founder Chris Larsen considered winding the company down and handing its XRP to shareholders before deciding to fight the 2020 lawsuit.
